content.short: dm3 is a messaging protocol focused on e2ee, scalability, decentralization, and interoperability.
content.description: dm3 provides a secure, intermediary-free method for exchanging messages. By standardizing how different messaging protocols, services, and dApps interact, it enables interoperability across diverse ecosystems. The protocol aligns messaging on a common set of specifications, making it easier for apps and services to connect, share data, and work together in a consistent and compatible manner. A common specification helps participants adopt and extend messaging capabilities in a consistent, predictable way.
